lines.text: Global Culinary Institute
Spring 2024
CULN 310 Advanced Techniques: Sous Vide
Course Description: This course explores the sous vide culinary
method, a meticulous process in which vacuum-sealed pouches are
placed in a water bath at a precisely controlled temperature. Students
who successfully complete the course will be able to harness their
knowledge of the biochemical interactions and thermal dynamics that
underly the sous vide technique to achieve optimal flavor profiles and
textural nuances. Successful students will also be able to demonstrate
their understanding of the historical progression and contemporary
adaptations of sous vide technology, engage with state-of-the-art sous
vide equipment, and critically evaluate the applications of the sous
vide technique in haute cuisine.
Prerequisites: CULN 110 (Foundational Culinary Arts) and CULN 153
(Introduction to Gastronomic Science). Enrollment is limited to
Culinary Arts advanced track students.
Department: Culinary Arts
Schedule: MWF 2–5 P.M. Credits: Three (3)
Instructor: Marie Dubois, Certified Master Chef
